title: finding(spec): GanttConfig.timeZone's describe says "persisted data stays real instants", which is false for date fields; objectui's zod mirror reuses the describe verbatim
body:
Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat #1 (`session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`, seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560), from objectui#10866 slice 4 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#10994) and its contract review `5873110729` on that PR, which verified it. ⛔ Not graded here. It belongs to the spec lane, because the text lives in `packages/spec/src`.

## The sentence

`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, the `GanttConfig` `timeZone` member's `.describe()`:

> Business time zone, an IANA name such as 'Asia/Shanghai': the chart's calendar — shift bands, day columns, snapping, the today line, date labels — renders in this zone's wall time for every viewer instead of the browser's zone; persisted data stays real instants. An invalid name falls back to the browser zone with a console warning

"persisted data stays real instants" is false for a `Field.date` column. Since objectui#10866 (slices 1 to 4, all on objectui `main` once PR objectui#10994 lands), a gantt drop on a date field writes the calendar day the bar was dropped on in the chart's calendar, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. That is the spec's own storage rule for a date (`temporalStorageForm`). Only a datetime field is written as a real instant.

## Reach
- The describe publishes into the spec's JSON Schema and its reference docs.
- objectui's `@object-ui/types` zod mirror reuses it verbatim: `stripImportedDefaults(SpecGanttConfigSchema).shape.timeZone` in `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`. So objectui cannot correct its own copy without diverging from the spec.
- objectui already corrected its TypeScript-side prose in PR objectstack-ai/objectui#10994: `GanttConfig.timeZone` in `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`, plugin-gantt's `GanttViewProps.timeZone`, and `makeTzShift`.

## A true replacement for the false clause

"a datetime value is still written as the real instant, and a date value as the calendar day it was dropped on in this zone's calendar (`YYYY-MM-DD`)"

One precision the spec lane may want to carry: near a DST change of the chart's zone or the viewer's, objectui's shim can currently place a day's midnight an hour early, which writes the day before. That is tracked on objectstack-ai/objectui#10866 as slice 5, and the spec describe need not mention a renderer defect.

Dedupe words: GanttConfig timeZone describe real instants, view.zod.ts timeZone persisted, gantt timeZone date field persists day.
